_notes: API: Sulfamethoxazole (SMX), from cotrimoxazole plate, diluted 1:6.
Label visible: 'Wt? RC 21.4'. Identified as cotrimoxazole by agent analysis of supplement PDF.
SMX 100% standard: 5 mg/mL / 6 (dilution) × 2 µL spotting = 1.667 µg/spot.
TMP 100% standard: 1 mg/mL / 6 × 2 µL = 0.333 µg/spot (second compound, higher Rf).
Only the 5 SMX spots are encoded here.
Lane order in portrait (left→right): 60%, 90%, 80%, 90%, 100%.
REBUILT 2026-07-10: original fixture (2026-06-29) had hand-transcribed corners
predating the CSV corner-export feature, which produced a scale-mismatched
warp — the recorded xFraction/yFraction landed on blank plate background,
well away from both the real SMX row and the higher-Rf TMP row that
auto-detection picked up instead. Re-ran interactively with the current
build (white top-hat, exact corners from CSV export). Auto-detection
initially caught the SMX row plus one spurious extra blob (off-row);
nudging the threshold from 1.0 to 1.05 dropped the spurious blob and
left exactly the 5 real SMX spots.
Corners recorded by the plugin are in EXIF-rotated portrait display space;
converted to landscape (px,py) -> (lx,ly) via lx=py, ly=(1949-1)-px.
Verified: re-warping with the converted corners reproduces the exact
1503x2963 corrected-image size reported by the interactive session.
Plate image: 41598_2022_17527_MOESM4_ESM.jpg (4096×1949 px).
Source: Hauk et al., Sci. Rep. 12, 13433 (2022), Supplementary Figure S4.
